baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 names what is prepared for an arriving guest, while words 3-4 place it at the bounded occasion of reckoning.
baseline_models.mechanism: The demonstrative identifies a prepared reception; the temporal-genitive construction assigns that reception to the occasion when accounts and recompense are decided.

activation_trace.role: Prepared fare for a guest supplies the hospitality frame and makes the demonstrative point to a designated reception.
A bounded day supplies the temporal container in which the reception becomes due.
Accounting and recompense turn hospitality into an assigned return rather than a neutral welcome.

changed_reading.before: This is merely something they receive on a named future day.
changed_reading.after: This is their deliberately prepared reception at the bounded occasion when recompense is assigned.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same construction joins an ordered placement or provision at word 2 to the debt range of word 4 on a specified day.
baseline_models.mechanism: A prepared allotment is placed at its proper temporal station, while the financial branch of د ي ن lets the day function like maturity or settlement rather than time alone.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in its proper station supplies the ordered allotment side of the model.
The bounded day functions as the allotment's maturity point.
Financial debt supplies the live settlement image beneath the broader judicial sense.

changed_reading.before: The day marks only a generic future judgment.
changed_reading.after: The day can also be heard as a maturity date when an ordered due is settled through their assigned reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding scene offers the service-forms of reception and then empties them: apparent shelter neither cools nor honors. The focus noun therefore closes the catalogue as anti-hospitality, not merely as a label for painful food.

activation_trace.role: Prepared guest-fare establishes the hospitality template that the context reverses.
Sheltering shade supplies an expected guest-service whose protective function is immediately frustrated.
Cooling supplies the relief explicitly denied, turning shelter into failed refreshment.
Nobility and generosity supply honored treatment explicitly denied, completing the inversion of welcome.

structural_cues: 56:43 presents a nominal shelter, and 56:44 coordinates two negations that remove both physical relief and social honor.
The focus demonstrative retrospectively gathers the preceding catalogue into one named reception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prepared guest-fare plus shelter, cooling, and honor branches under explicit negation; I infer deliberate inversion of hospitality, while a live alternative is a torment list with no ironic reception-frame.

changed_reading.before: Their reception is severe but still structurally ordinary hospitality.
changed_reading.after: The demonstrative names an anti-banquet in which shelter, refreshment, and honored-guest treatment appear only as systematically reversed functions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior unrestrained ease is followed by persistent culpability, then universal collection at a fixed appointment. That sequence strengthens the debt branch of the focus construction: conduct accumulates before a due date at which its prepared return is delivered.

activation_trace.role: Prepared provision supplies the concrete form in which the due settlement is delivered.
Debt supplies the accrual-and-settlement model beneath the judicial occasion.
Expansive ease that releases restraint supplies the prior condition from which liability is inferred to accrue.
Persistence supplies repeated continuation rather than an isolated charge.
Culpable burden supplies what the settlement model treats as accumulated liability.
Collecting the dispersed supplies compulsory consolidation of all liable parties.
A fixed appointment supplies the maturity date at which the accumulated account is settled.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from a prior habitual condition through persistence and denial to total gathering at one known appointment.
56:50 repeats the focus root ي و م before 56:56 names that day by د ي ن.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior ease, persistent culpability, total gathering, and a fixed appointment; I assign the arrow from repeated conduct to accrued liability and from appointment to maturity, while ordinary judicial accounting remains a fully live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The financial resonance of the focus construction is an isolated lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The known appointment and behavior-chain make the day behave like a maturity date: their prepared reception is the due settlement of what has accumulated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered intake fills bodily capacity but does not satisfy need: eating becomes gulping, fullness leads to aversive drinking, and drinking culminates in thirst that cannot be quenched. The prepared fare is thus a designed failure of provision.

activation_trace.role: Prepared guest-fare supplies the provisioning function whose failure organizes the sequence.
An edible share or provision links the commanded eating directly to the reception's fare.
Gulping and swallowing turn provision into compelled incorporation.
Filling to the measure of a container supplies bodily capacity reached without nourishment.
The body's interior supplies the container occupied by the failed provision.
Drinking with aversion supplies intake that necessity drives despite its hostility.
Unquenchable thirst supplies the terminal non-satisfaction that converts a meal into a punitive cycle.

structural_cues: Consecutive participial clauses linked by ف move from eating to filling to drinking, while 56:54-55 repeat the drinking root.
Capacity increases and need persists, so the sequence opposes fullness to satisfaction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered intake, bodily fullness, aversive drink, and unquenchable thirst; I infer a feedback mechanism in which intake fails to resolve and may perpetuate need, while a linear sequence of repeated compulsion remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The reception consists of painful food and drink.
changed_reading.after: The reception is a systematically failed provision: it occupies capacity while perpetuating the need that provision should end.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reverses ordinary guest movement: the served reception becomes what descends into and takes up residence in the recipients. It remains anchored in the descent range of ن ز ل and the explicit penetration-and-filling sequence; downstream prose should present it as a spatial-material activation, not as a claim that the focus noun lexically means bodily invasion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 permits both prepared reception and downward arrival or settling, allowing the context's inward movement to reverse who occupies whom.

activation_trace.role: Downward arrival and settling supply the vector re-read from guests entering a lodging to punitive material entering recipients.
Penetrating hot wind begins the inward vector before the explicit ingestion sequence.
Filling a container to capacity supplies occupation rather than external accompaniment.
The bodily interior supplies the occupied lodging in the reversed spatial model.

changed_reading.before: They descend upon a punitive lodging and consume what it offers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the punitive reception descends into them and makes their interiors its occupied lodging.

strongest_changes: The denied cooling and honor recast prepared guest-fare as a precise inversion of hospitality.
The fixed gathering after persistent culpability strengthens a maturity-date reading of the day of settlement.
The eating-filling-drinking sequence turns fare into failed provision that fills capacity without satisfying need.
summary.what_was_special: The focus line acts as a retrospective naming device: one compact hospitality term gathers spatial shelter, social honor, temporal settlement, and bodily intake, then lets the context reverse each normal service.
remaining_uncertainties: The debt-settlement model is branch-supported but may remain subordinate to the broader judicial-recompense sense.
The reversed-descent outlier depends on a reader-supplied spatial reversal and should not be lexicalized.
